purpose: Preserve the accelerated orchestration logic across chat sessions while keeping scientific and safety gates unchanged.
startup_logic: Verify current public master and current operational/evidence state before acting.
Snapshot live runner, workflow, agent and bounded mobile capacity; never trust stale availability claims.
Route every meaningful task to the smallest suitable free resource and execute independent work in parallel.

Treat Windows A and B as always-routable primary research capacity, not fallback. Keep both lanes moving in parallel whenever independent bounded work is available; do not wait for the other lane to finish.

Do not leave a reachable configured research runner idle while a useful independent bounded backlog exists: after successful completion, replenish the lane immediately through deterministic completion chaining.

When a candidate-specific workpack finishes, immediately route the next ready gate from the active registry. If the scientific frontier is temporarily blocked, route deterministic provenance/PIT/data-contract/negative-evidence QA instead of manufacturing research.
Default S10 routing is deterministic mechanical QA; event-driven semantic utility review remains explicit and non-default.
Do not duplicate already-running work and do not consume quotas merely to create activity.
completed_round_chaining: When a bounded research round or runner lane completes successfully, immediately route the next receipt-defined independent round/task when prerequisites are satisfied. Completion chaining must be event-driven where the platform supports it; the existing cron remains a recovery/health-check path. Never leave an eligible research lane intentionally idle while useful bounded backlog exists.
research_pipeline: Orthogonal information first; prioritize genuinely distinct information clocks and economic mechanisms.
Cheap falsification before expensive formal work.
Expose robustness dimensions before any future performance authorization.
When a candidate completes all formal gates, trigger the predeclared unchanged independent replication immediately.
Immutable reconciliation and formal governance remain prerequisites to interpretation or promotion.

lane_a_formal_readiness.purpose: Coverage/PIT/authorization readiness for fully pre-registered candidates; candidate-specific compiler and provenance closure.
lane_a_formal_readiness.current_focus: Q104:I19 remaining historical 13F/security PIT closure, immutable preregistration/authorization readiness and exact independent reproduction
lane_a_formal_readiness.performance_allowed: only when the active research registry contains an exact true performance_authorization_allowed for that independent frozen trial

lane_b_frontier_discovery.purpose: Orthogonal source/PIT feasibility, cheap falsification and new information-channel discovery.
lane_b_frontier_discovery.current_focus: Q220, Q228, Q224 and Q227 source/PIT/clock feasibility with cheap falsification; Q218/Q221/Q219 as next independent frontier

runner_c_independent_reproduction_and_lo.purpose: Long deterministic archival parsing, independent reproduction, source/PIT census and materially useful cross-checks that do not duplicate Lane A/B work.
runner_c_independent_reproduction_and_lo.current_focus: Q104:I19 independent reproduction when its exact frozen contract is ready; otherwise the highest-priority independent Q220/Q228/Q224/Q227 archive/source workload.
runner_c_independent_reproduction_and_lo.performance_allowed: false unless an exact independent performance trial has its own current formal authorization; default role remains pre-performance research/reproduction.

self_hosted_windows.windows_pulse_cadence: 10 minutes plus event-driven pushes; each lane remains continuously routable and independently concurrency-protected
self_hosted_windows.continuity_rule: When research is needed, use all three Windows slots whenever three mutually independent bounded workpacks exist: A = formal readiness, B = frontier discovery, C = independent reproduction/long deterministic research. Do not reserve C merely as nominal failover capacity. When only two independent workpacks exist, use the third slot for a materially useful downstream-preparation, provenance, PIT, archival or negative-evidence QA task. Idle is valid only when no independent useful bounded workpack exists.

mobile.recurring_schedule: every 20 minutes plus meaningful research/governance push events
mobile.semantic_ai: manual/explicit utility or acceptance only; no default routing
mobile.routing_rule: Keep S10 continuously routable for bounded mechanical research QA; rotate task classes and skip active duplicates.

lane_isolation.rule: Separate candidate/trial IDs, branches/workflows, immutable receipts and output paths; no shared mutable research state between lanes.
lane_isolation.cross_lane_transfer: Only as a new explicitly frozen hypothesis after review; never mutate an already-frozen lane because of the other lane's results.

parallelism_policy.performance_capacity_rule: Two physical slots never create performance authorization. Parallel performance execution is permitted only when each exact trial has its own current formal authorization; otherwise performance remains fail-closed.

phone_capacity_policy.decision: Do not add another physical phone merely for nominal capacity.
phone_capacity_policy.current_state: S10 plus prepared Samsung fleet slots are sufficient for the present architecture.
phone_capacity_policy.activation_rule: Activate at most one additional Samsung device as a controlled capacity test when measured independent throughput gain is expected.
phone_capacity_policy.promotion_rule: Keep an additional device in recurring routing only when its measured workload throughput and reliability justify the extra operational complexity.
phone_capacity_policy.scientific_role: bounded QA/review/support only; no evidence, selection, ranking, authorization, promotion or live execution.

literature_discovery.principle: Continuously discover unusual, economically coherent and genuinely orthogonal information advantages; verify before adoption and preserve dead ends.
literature_discovery.anti_duplicate_rule: Do not keep a separate candidate when the proposed mechanism empirically collapses to an existing lineage; merge Q217 back into Q131 if processing-friction decomposition is not distinct.

integration_rules.speculative_language: predeclared control/alternative explanation for Q217/Q131, not a new candidate
integration_rules.customer_related_disclosures: pre-call business press coverage may be an identification control for Q212, not a second signal family
integration_rules.crsp_history_revision: hard reproducibility QA, not a candidate

rolling_capacity_wave_control.rule: When useful free capacity exists and a non-duplicate bounded backlog exists, keep the lane occupied with the highest-priority ready task.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.phase_rule: Skip active duplicates; skip phase-successful work; allow at most one retry after failure/cancellation; downstream workflows retain their own fail-closed gates.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.permanent_extension: The rule is permanent. Event-driven completion replenishment is the primary continuity path for A/B; scheduled pulses are recovery/health checks. Runner C chains through its prepared workpack dependencies. No runtime padding is permitted.
rolling_capacity_wave_control.dispatch_authority: capacity-saturation-rolling-waves.yml = sole automatic dispatcher; priority-research-wave-dispatch.yml = manual-only
rolling_capacity_wave_control.anti_scheinbeschäftigung: Do not rerun successful source probes or tests merely to occupy a runner. Route only defined receipt-dependent next gates, independent reproductions, candidate/source/PIT closures, or materially useful governance/provenance QA. Idle is valid only when no useful independent executable backlog exists.

chat_continuity.rule: Persist material state before reporting completion; chat transcript is never the sole state store; do not commit for every message absent material state change.

useful_capacity_rule.statement: Es darf keine künstliche Arbeit erzeugt werden. Ausschließlich wertvolle und hilfreiche Rechenarbeit darf ausgeführt werden. Und das so viel wie möglich.
useful_capacity_rule.english_equivalent: No artificial work may be created. Only valuable and helpful compute work may be executed, and as much of it as possible.
useful_capacity_rule.operational_rule: A useful backlog plus free reachable capacity implies immediate routing. Use all three Windows research slots when three independent useful bounded workpacks exist; completion-triggered replenishment is preferred over waiting for cron. Never create padding, duplicate a live workpack, or rerun successful work solely to increase utilization.
idle_is_valid_only_when: no independent executable bounded workpack exists
a required scientific dependency is genuinely blocked
the resource is reserved by a higher-priority independent run
a hard capacity/quota/entitlement constraint prevents safe execution

knowledge_relation_plane.purpose: Reuse deterministic source/clock/identity infrastructure across independent candidate lanes and discover cross-channel state-transition motifs without inheriting scientific conclusions.
knowledge_relation_plane.scheduler_rule: Prioritize unresolved shared structural components by the number of independent downstream tasks they unblock; never use performance outcomes for this priority.
knowledge_relation_plane.composition_rule: Graph relations do not create composite candidates. Any composition requires a separate frozen contract and independent candidate-specific PIT/coverage/reproduction gates.
knowledge_relation_plane.w4_role: metadata consolidation, overlap audit, dependency routing and negative-evidence deduplication

temporal_identity_state_spine.rule: Never collapse occurrence time, public-observation time, identity validity or state transition into a single timestamp/label.
temporal_identity_state_spine.routing: Resolve shared temporal/identity/state prerequisites once; fan out candidate-specific PIT, revision and mapping gates.
